arxiv-2101-07245.title: Anisotropy, biased pairings, and the Lefschetz property for pseudomanifolds and cycles
arxiv-2101-07245.creator: Karim Alexander Adiprasito, Stavros Argyrios Papadakis, Vasiliki Petrotou
arxiv-2101-07245.description: Abstract . We prove the hard Lefschetz property for pseudomanifolds and cycles in any characteristic with respect to an appropriate Artinian reduction. The proof is a combination of Adiprasito’s biased pairing theory and a generalization of a formula of Papadakis-Petrotou to arbitrary characteristic.

arxiv-2104-08249.title: Uncovering near-wall blood flow from sparse data with physics-informed neural networks
arxiv-2104-08249.creator: Amirhossein Arzani, Jian-Xun Wang, Roshan M. D’Souza
arxiv-2104-08249.description: Abstract Near-wall blood flow and wall shear stress (WSS) regulate major forms of cardiovascular disease, yet they are challenging to quantify with high fidelity. Patient-specific computational and experimental measurement of WSS suffers from uncertainty, low resolution, and noise issues. Physics-informed neural networks (PINN) provide a flexible deep learning framework to integrate mathematical equations governing blood flow with measurement data.

arxiv-2201-13210.title: THE BACKGROUND FIELD METHOD APPLIED TO COSMOLOGICAL PHASE TRANSITION
arxiv-2201-13210.description: Abstract In this paper, the cosmological phase transition is investigated by background gauge field method. As a continuation of previous our work, some numerical results and graphic solutions at T ≠ 0 T\neq 0 are presented. Hence the mechanism of cosmological phase transition in the early Universe is considered.

arxiv-2202-09694.title: MACRONYM: A Large-Scale Dataset for Multilingual and Multi-Domain Acronym Extraction
arxiv-2202-09694.creator: Amir Pouran Ben Veyseh, Nicole Meister, Seunghyun Yoon, Rajiv Jain, Franck Dernoncourt, Thien Huu Nguyen
arxiv-2202-09694.description: Abstract Acronym extraction is the task of identifying acronyms and their expanded forms in texts that is necessary for various NLP applications. Despite major progress for this task in recent years, one limitation of existing AE research is that they are limited to the English language and certain domains (i.e., scientific and biomedical).

arxiv-2203-11885.title: Biased 2 × 2 2\times 2 periodic Aztec diamond and an elliptic curve
arxiv-2203-11885.creator: Alexei Borodin, Maurice Duits
arxiv-2203-11885.description: Abstract We study random domino tilings of the Aztec diamond with a biased 2 × 2 2\times 2 periodic weight function and associate a linear flow on an elliptic curve to this model. Our main result is a double integral formula for the correlation kernel, in which the integrand is expressed in terms of this flow.

arxiv-2305-07698.title: Global constraints on non-standard neutrino interactions with quarks and electrons Preprint: IFT-UAM/CSIC-23-47, IFIC/23-15, FTUV-23-0427.3710, YITP-SB-2023-05
arxiv-2305-07698.creator: Pilar Coloma, M. C. Gonzalez-Garcia, Michele Maltoni, João Paulo Pinheiro, Salvador Urrea
arxiv-2305-07698.description: Abstract We derive new constraints on effective four-fermion neutrino non-standard interactions with both quarks and electrons. This is done through the global analysis of neutrino oscillation data and measurements of coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering (CE ν \nu NS) obtained with different nuclei.

arxiv-2502-18691.title: Enhancing Image Classification with Augmentation: Data Augmentation Techniques for Improved Image Classification
arxiv-2502-18691.creator: Saroj Kumar*, Ugochukwu Esiowu, Prince Asiamah, Oluwatoyin Jolaoso
arxiv-2502-18691.description: Abstract Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) serve as the workhorse of deep learning, finding applications in various fields that rely on images. Given sufficient data, they exhibit the capacity to learn a wide range of concepts across diverse settings. However, a notable limitation of CNNs is their susceptibility to overfitting when trained on small datasets.

arxiv-2504-16581.title: Revisiting Regret Benchmarks in Online Non-Stochastic Control
arxiv-2504-16581.creator: Vijeth Hebbar, Cédric Langbort
arxiv-2504-16581.description: Abstract In the online non-stochastic control problem, an agent sequentially selects control inputs for a linear dynamical system when facing unknown and adversarially selected convex costs and disturbances. A common metric for evaluating control policies in this setting is policy regret, defined relative to the best-in-hindsight linear feedback controller.

arxiv-2506-14233.title: Narrate2Nav: Real-Time Visual Navigation with Implicit Language Reasoning in Human-Centric Environments
arxiv-2506-14233.creator: Amirreza Payandeh, Anuj Pokhrel, Daeun Song, Marcos Zampieri, Xuesu Xiao
arxiv-2506-14233.description: Abstract Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated potential in enhancing mobile robot navigation in human-centric environments by understanding contextual cues, human intentions, and social dynamics while exhibiting reasoning capabilities. However, their computational complexity and limited sensitivity to continuous numerical data impede real-time performance and precise motion control.

arxiv-2507-20774.title: evalSmarT: An LLM-Based Framework for Evaluating Smart Contract Generated Comments
arxiv-2507-20774.creator: Fatou Ndiaye Mbodji 1 , Mame Marieme C. Sougoufara 2 , Wendkûuni A. M. Christian Ouedraogo 1 , Alioune Diallo 1 , Kui Liu 3 , Jacques Klein 1 , Tegawendé F. Bissyandé 1
arxiv-2507-20774.description: Abstract Smart contract comment generation has gained traction as a means to improve code comprehension and maintainability in blockchain systems. However, evaluating the quality of generated comments remains a challenge. Traditional metrics such as BLEU and ROUGE fail to capture domain-specific nuances, while human evaluation is costly and unscalable.

pmc-10559609.creator: Yun Li, Wenxin Gu, Huijun Yue, Guoqing Lei, Wenbin Guo, Yihui Wen, Haocheng Tang, Xin Luo, Wenjuan Tu, Jin Ye, Ruomei Hong, Qian Cai, Qingyu Gu, Tianrun Liu, Beiping Miao, Ruxin Wang, Jiangtao Ren, Wenbin Lei

pmc-10619110.title: Associations of health-related quality of life with major adverse cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events for individuals with ischaemic heart disease: systematic review, meta-analysis and evidence mapping
pmc-10619110.creator: Anzhela Soloveva, Chris P Gale, Han Naung Tun, Ben Hurdus, Suleman Aktaa, Victoria Palin, Teumzghi F Mebrahtu, Harriette Van Spall, Gorav Batra, Tatendashe Bernadette Dondo, Maria Bäck, Theresa Munyombwe
pmc-10619110.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectiveTo investigate the association between health-related quality of life (HRQoL) and major adverse cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events (MACCE) in individuals with ischaemic heart disease (IHD).MethodsMedline(R), Embase, APA PsycINFO and CINAHL (EBSCO) from inception to 3 April 2023 were searched. Studies reporting association of HRQoL, using a generic or cardiac-specific tool, with MACCE or components of MACCE for individuals with IHD were eligible for inclusion. Risk of bias was assessed using the Newcastle-Ottawa Quality Assessment Scale to assess the quality of the studies.

pmc-11727162.title: Polymeric Nanoparticles Potentiate the Anticancer Activity of Novel PI3Kα Inhibitors Against Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Cells
pmc-11727162.creator: Suhair Sunoqrot, Samah Abusulieh, Dima Sabbah, Fernando de Carvalho da Silva, Bruno Kaufmann Robbs
pmc-11727162.description: Background: Dysregulation in phosphoinositide-3-kinase alpha (PI3Kα) signaling is implicated in the development of various cancers, including triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC). We have previously synthesized a series of N-phenyl-6-chloro-4-hydroxy-2-quinolone-3-carboxamides as targeted inhibitors against PI3Kα. Herein, two drug candidates, R7 and R11, were selected to be further investigated as a nanoparticle (NP) formulation against TNBC.

pmc-12489230.title: The Incidence Rate of Hamstring Injuries in Non-Professional Athletes and Their Injury Management Patterns
pmc-12489230.creator: Ahmad Dzaky Arkan, Meiky Fredianto
pmc-12489230.description: Objectives:The primary objectives of this study are to characterize the frequency of hamstring injuries among non-professional athletes and the kinds of treatments they use when an injury occurs.Methods:This study, which used questionnaires to collect data from Yogyakarta, Indonesia’s sports community, focused on three sports: soccer, cycling, and running. the information gathered in July 2023.

pmc-12722654.title: Navigating goals of care discussion in palliative care: A qualitative study applying Bourdieu’s theory of practice
pmc-12722654.creator: Haiyang Lin, Shiyong Tan, Yufei Huang, Haojie Duan, Yumei Li, Yanping Hao
pmc-12722654.description: Background:Nowadays, effective communication has become indispensable with the increasing prevalence of advanced life-limiting diseases. Goals of care discussion (GOCD) align care with patients’ preferences and improve care quality.Objectives:This paper probes deep into the dilemmas and summarizes strategies of medical staff conducting GOCD from the viewpoint of human-environment interaction.Design:Qualitative study comprising semi-structured in-depth interviews.

pmc-12817066.creator: Árpád Kézdi, Viktor J. Horváth, Viktor Vass, Márk M. Svébis, Győző Kocsis, Viktória Ferencz, Tamás Jávorfi, Beatrix A. Domján, Ádám G. Tabák
pmc-12817066.description: IntroductionThe “dead-in-bed” syndrome is thought to be a consequence of hypoglycaemia-induced QTc prolongation in type 1 diabetes. pmc-13187704.title: Online Discussions of Men’s Mental Health on Reddit and YouTube: Cross-Sectional Mixed-Methods Infodemiological Study
pmc-13187704.creator: Anurag Shekhar, Musawenkosi Donia Saurombe
pmc-13187704.description: BackgroundMale mental health remains a major global concern, with men underrepresented in mental health care and overrepresented in suicide statistics. Masculine norms that link emotional restraint with strength can discourage help-seeking and vulnerability. Anonymous digital spaces such as Reddit (Reddit Inc) and YouTube (Google LLC) have become informal support environments where men share experiences and emotions outside traditional constraints.
